paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: GPU Memory Cost. We apply all the experiments on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage in gigabytes for different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and is on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 200 frames. The y-axis is labeled "Memory (GB)" and is also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 400 gigabytes, with tick labels at intervals of 50 gigabytes. There are five lines in the plot. The pink line with circle markers and a solid style represents "VideoLaMB", is metioned, but isn't there in the graph. The brown line with circle markers and a solid style represents "VideoLLAMB-R", is and increases gradually from approximately 10 GB at 0 frames to about 40 GB at 1100 frames. The green line with circle markers and a solid style represents "PLLaVA", which also increases steadily from about 10 GB to just above 75 GB at 1100 frames. The teal line with circle markers and a solid style represents "LLaVA-NeXT", showing an increase from around 10 GB at the start to about 150 GB at 1100 frames. The purple line with circle markers and a dashed style represents "VideoLLAVA", starting at slightly above 10 GB and escalating sharply, reaching around 225 GB at 250 frames, and sharply goes beyond the graph range in between 200 and 300 frames. A legend is given top left, describing the lines and color.
